stories.summary: Asian stock markets fell Friday after a widespread sell-off of artificial intelligence issues on Wall Street. stories.title: RBI to discuss credit loss framework with banks
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will meet stakeholders on November 12 to discuss the proposed Expected Credit Loss provisioning framework. Banks are seeking a review of provisioning percentages and flexibility to spread the additional burden over multiple years. The central bank remains open to industry feedback on the proposal.

stories.title: Sebi revises currency derivative position limits
stories.summary: Sebi has revised limits for unhedged currency derivative positions, allowing domestic clients and foreign portfolio investors to take positions up to $5 million without underlying exposure. The new rules align Sebi regulations with the Reserve Bank of India circular issued on October 10, 2026.

stories.title: RBI extends restrictions on two cooperative banks
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has extended regulatory directions on Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd, Dehradun, and The Pusad Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd, Maharashtra. The restrictions for the Dehradun bank will now run until February 10, 2027, while the Pusad bank remains under direction until February 7, 2027.

stories.title: Administrator flags CSR fund use by private banks
stories.summary: Vidyadhar V. Anaskar has asked the Reserve Bank of India to investigate the alleged misuse of Corporate Social Responsibility funds by private banks. The administrator claims banks are using these funds to secure deposits from government institutions. He has requested an independent probe into the reported practices.

stories.title: RBI proposes consolidated PSL rules for UCBs
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has proposed a consolidated regulatory framework for priority sector lending by urban cooperative banks. The move aims to simplify existing instructions while keeping the overall lending target at 60 percent. Stakeholders have until November 26, 2026, to provide comments on the draft.

stories.title: RBI consolidates cybersecurity rules for payment operators
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has issued a consolidated cybersecurity framework for non-bank payment system operators. The rules cover software security, audits, and cyberattack reporting. Large and medium operators must comply immediately, while smaller firms have until April 1, 2028. The central bank has combined its previous directions.

stories.title: RBI proposes loan limit for agri infrastructure
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has proposed a 100 crore rupee aggregate loan limit per borrower for agricultural infrastructure and food processing to qualify as priority sector lending. The draft aims to improve institutional credit flow to underserved sectors. Banks would need to sanction separate limits for these activities.

stories.title: NPCI defends UPI charges in Supreme Court
stories.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India told the Supreme Court that merchant discount rates on UPI transactions are justified and narrowly targeted. The corporation stated the levy applies to only 4 percent of transactions exceeding 2,000 rupees. The charge is currently deferred until after the Diwali holiday.

stories.title: Sebi reviews growth platform for startups
stories.summary: Sebi has formed an 18-member working group to review the regulatory framework for the Innovators Growth Platform. The review aims to improve capital market access for research-stage and technology-intensive enterprises. The regulator noted that the innovation ecosystem has evolved significantly to include deep-tech, biotechnology, and semiconductor firms.

stories.title: Sebi allows managers to certify accredited investors
stories.summary: Sebi has introduced a manager-led mechanism for determining accredited investor status. Managers of alternative investment funds and portfolio managers can now certify eligible investors without using a recognised accreditation agency. The status determination will be recognised across managers belonging to the same corporate group.

stories.title: NPCI creates tech and innovation unit
stories.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India has established a subsidiary, NPCI Tech Solutions Limited, to focus on AI and blockchain. The new arm will manage digital financial infrastructure and Global Capability Centre services. Vishal Kanvaty has been appointed as the managing director and chief executive officer.

stories.title: Pine Labs targets UPI growth
stories.summary: Pine Labs is targeting a monthly gross transaction value of 33,000 to 34,000 crore rupees by fiscal year 2028. stories.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India has told the Supreme Court that merchants cannot pass merchant discount rate charges to customers. stories.title: Section 270AA and tax penalty relief
stories.summary: Salaried taxpayers facing scrutiny for incorrect HRA or deduction claims may be liable for penalties up to 200 percent of the tax payable under Section 270A. Section 270AA may offer a path to relief for those who have misreported income. The law provides for varying levels of scrutiny.

stories.title: SEBI proposes LTCG tax relief for mutual funds
stories.summary: SEBI has proposed that investors be exempted from long term capital gains tax when selling existing holdings to reinvest in new ones. SBI estimates the move could reduce government revenue by 40,000 to 50,000 crore rupees. The Finance Ministry has yet to decide on the pre-budget proposal.
